verifiedCause.summary: Distinct-source breadth passed nominally, but the retrieval planner did not implement its per-facet parameter and lexical matches were too weak to guarantee semantic clause coverage.
codeEvidence: per_facet affected ranking pool size but was not passed into plan_bounded_supports
explicit alternatives joined by or remained one facet
planner ranked source novelty ahead of relevance for equal coverage counts
any positive lexical overlap counted as dimension coverage

patchProposal.expectedEffect: Increase relevant-document recall by splitting answer roles and alternatives, expanding only generic intent vocabulary, and enforcing distinct-authority coverage per facet before filling the global source floor.

consolidation.reason: A single development failure can justify a narrow child proposal but cannot validate or promote it.
